name: Merge multiple ROIs together using AFNI
summary: Merges selected ROIs from an rois dataset into new combined ROIs with AFNI 3dcalc, for left and right hemisphere lists and a chosen output name.
description: Utility that reads an rois directory, combines the ROIs whose numbers are listed in mergeROIsL and mergeROIsR (one line per merged ROI) into new ROIs named ROI<mergename>.nii.gz, and outputs them with the original ROIs. Use it to build larger ROIs (for example a lobe or a functional network) from smaller ones before tracking or functional analysis. ROI numbers refer to the input file names (ROI<number>.nii.gz).

inputs.description: Directory of binary NIfTI ROIs named ROI<number>.nii.gz to be merged.

outputs.description: The directory containing all of the ROIs

parameters.description:
Left hemisphere ROI numbers you would like to merge into a single ROI

if the user wants to merge multiple ROIs made from subset of all ROIs, enter each set of ROIs on a new line. the mergename field will need to correspond to these pairings (i.e. same number of pairings per left and right hemisphere, same order)

ex. freesurfer-11111 freesurfer-111112
freesurfer-11113 freesurfer-11114 freesurfer-11115

Right hemisphere ROI numbers you would like to merge into a single ROI.

if the user wants to merge multiple ROIs made from subset of all ROIs, enter each set of ROIs on a new line. the mergename field will need to correspond to these pairings (i.e. same number of pairings per left and right hemisphere, same order)

ex. freesurfer-12111 freesurfer-121112
freesurfer-12113 freesurfer-12114 freesurfer-12115

Name for the ROI that you would like merged. The output will be in the following format: ROI${mergename}.nii.gz

if the user wants to merge multiple ROIs made from subset of all ROIs, enter each name on a line. this field will need to correspond to these pairings (i.e. same number of pairings per left and right hemisphere, same order)

ex. test1
test2
